cells.note: Fact 2026-11-05: Algerie Telecom's CEO says in 2026 its backbone fibre covers every wilaya (DZA-004, with L'Echo d'Algerie, DZA-003), later than the 2025 report of 95 per cent of the territory; Algerie Telecom leases over 40,000 km of fibre to operators and supplies the mobile operators' capacity (DZA-006, DZA-005).
